go_semantics: Both trees declare go 1.22 in go.mod. The labels assume Go 1.22 language semantics and standard library, built by a Go 1.22 or later toolchain with this module as the main module.

expected_findings.defect: `Healthy` never closes `resp.Body`, so each health check leaks the response body and keeps its connection from being reused, eventually exhausting connections or file descriptors.
expected_findings.rationale: The `net/http` client requires the caller to close a non-nil response body. `Version` in the same file defers the close; `Healthy` returns without it on every path that has a response.
